The regex `matrix_re` excludes `o_proj.weight` (only lists q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj), so only 6 of 7 projection matrices per layer are cast, yielding 96 bfloat16 tensors instead of the required 112 — violating clause 1 ("Cast exactly the 112 projection matrices").
